Introduction-content: “{{gameName}}” is an online slot game with attractive gameplay and gripping graphics. The game includes 5 reels and 3 rows, with 11 different symbols. The Player will win if the same symbols are located on the same payline that has been chosen.
GameRule-line-1: The Player selects the Paylines (Lines) and sets the Bet Level you want to place bet before pressing “Spin”.
GameRule-line-2: 25 Paylines are numbered from 1 to 25, and the Player must choose at least one Payline before starting the game.
GameRule-line-3: By default, all Paylines with the minimum Bet Level will be selected at the beginning.
GameRule-line-4: The Win-loss on each Payline will be calculated based on the number of the same symbols located on that Payline.
GameRule-line-jackpot: There are 3 options for Bet amount; for each option, the Player will have the opportunity to win an attractive Jackpot prize.
Paytable-line-1: The winning amount is calculated according to the betting odds.
Paytable-line-3: All winning amounts are instantly added to your account balance when bets are settled.
Jackpot-line-1: Jackpot is a grand prize for Player having 5 symbols
Jackpot-line-2: located on the same payline. There are 3 Jackpot prizes corresponding with 3 bet levels and all Jackpots are progressive, where every time the game is played, a portion of the bet amount is contributed to the Jackpots until one lucky Player wins the Jackpot.
Jackpot-example-1: The Player will win the Jackpot prize if there are 5 symbols located on the same payline that has been chosen.
Jackpot-example-2: Note: Player will receive 98% of the Jackpot prize.
FreeSpin-line-1: Player will receive Free Spins Bonus corresponding to the number of Free Spins symbols having in the result.
FreeSpin-line-2: The Free Spin symbols do not have to be on the same payline.
FreeSpin-line-3: Note: The “Free Spin” symbols must appear in different reels. For example, if there are 3 “Free Spin” symbols on the same reel, the system will count as one symbol.
FreeSpin-line-4: There are 4 “Free Spin” symbols in the result, but 3 symbols are located on the same reel. The player is not eligible for the Free spins bonus.
FreeSpin-line-5: Free Spins are played at the same Bet Level and same number of paylines as the last spin (the spin on which the User gets the Free Spins Bonus).
FreeSpin-line-6: The Player must complete Free Spins Bonus within 24hrs after being issued. Unused Free Spins will be lost.
Bonus-line-1: Having 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols appearing anywhere in the result will trigger the Bonus Game.
Bonus-line-2: The Bonus symbols do not have to be on the same payline.
Bonus-line-3: Note: The Bonus symbols must appear in different reels. For example, if 2 or 3 Bonus symbols appearing on the same reel, the system will count as one symbol.
Bonus-line-4: There are 4 “Bonus” symbols in the result, but 2 symbols are located on the same reel. The player is only eligible for 3 items.
Bonus-line-5: Player has to complete the Bonus Game within 120 seconds of countdown. After this period, the system will randomly open items and settle the game round.
Wild-line-1: “Wild” symbol can substitute for all symbols except
Wild-line-2: Only the highest achieved win per line is paid out.
Wild-example-description-3: Player will get the highest win on this payline => Payout = Bet Level * {{odd}}
TermsAndConditions-line-1: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets because of a force majeure event including but not limited to any technical errors, network service failures, power failures.
TermsAndConditions-line-2: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets of players we believe to be involved in fraud, money laundering, or any other form of illegal or suspicious activities.
TermsAndConditions-line-3: The Company reserves the right to cancel or void any bets when there is an error (caused by human or any other factors), or a system failure resulting in the wrong betting odds.
TermsAndConditions-line-4: All accepted bets will still be effective even if the member subsequently logs out or is disconnected from the site for any reason.
